theorem lg_target {E : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {f : UpperHalfPlane → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) (hf_infinity : UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty f) (hf_inv : ∀ (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), f (g • τ) = f τ) : ∃ C, ∀ (τ : UpperHalfPlane), ‖f τ‖ ≤ C := by
  let ⟨M, A⟩ := UpperHalfPlane.isBoundedAtImInfty_iff hf_infinity
  let h_compact := Continuous.continuousOn_compact (UpperHalfPlane.compact_half_plane A)
  let h_bound_compact := hf_cont.continuousOn_boundedOn h_compact
  let h_bound_compact' := h_bound_compact M
  let C := max M (h_bound_compact'.1)
  exact ⟨C, λ τ, max_le C M (h_bound_compact'.2 τ)⟩
